findings.description: The separator logic was inverted during the refactor. The original code was `("; " if any_prefix_is_slash else " / ").join(rv)`, but the new code is `("; " if not any_prefix_is_slash else " / ").join(rv)`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any option with both primary and secondary opts, such as `--flag/--no-flag`. Before the change, the separator was " / " when no slash prefix was used, and "; " when a slash prefix was used. Now it is "; " for ordinary options and " / " for slash-prefixed ones. Help output changes from `--shout / --no-shout` to `--shout; --no-shout`, and slash-prefix options also get the wrong separator.
